_doc: Shared by crates/edge (assign.rs/manifest.rs tests) and lib/ab/serve.test.ts. manifest is an object (stringified), or {raw}. request.path is an already-resolved URL path; query has no leading '?'; ua/lang/cookie are header values (non-ASCII = present but unreadable); nowMs is Unix ms. expect is null (no experiment decision, incl. no manifest) or a subset of the decision. Regenerate with gen-evaluate.cjs (node, from the repo root) if the contract changes.
